title: Blood Glucose Test
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: A random (non-fasting) glucose measures blood sugar at any time of day. Glucose is the body's main energy source, and levels outside the usual range may be a sign of prediabetes, diabetes or other conditions.
low: Possible causes of a low result include diabetes medicines, eating too little, unusual activity, liver or kidney disease, underactive adrenal glands or thyroid, malnutrition, alcohol use disorder and some medicines.
high: Prediabetes and diabetes are the most common causes of a high result; others include an overactive thyroid, pancreas problems, stress from surgery or serious illness, adrenal gland problems and certain medicines.
notes: This application has no verified reference interval for a random glucose, so it reports the value without judging it. Interpretation depends on the test type, other results and medical history.
